content.comment_body: I'm working with the German version of [product_name] TD, but keep receiving this error message. Any advice?

Have you used the M27 flag somewhere in your configuration? That flag enables a secondary level for message text, similar to a shift function. If the second level has no text assigned, this error will occur. Otherwise, please share your configuration.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences a recurring error about missing messages when using the German version of [product_name] TD. The issue appears to stem from the configuration settings, not a hardware fault. The product does not identify which specific settings cause the problem, leading to confusion and prompting the user to seek assistance in the forum.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] TD to display messages correctly and to indicate which configuration elements are missing, if any, providing clearer troubleshooting guidance.
